methodology: oracle ranking is rank_build_tower_actions_by_heuristic (coverage, then route distance, then damage) over the full oracle BuildTower candidate set (no position limit); a real rollout evaluation over the full oracle set is computationally intractable, so this is a rollout-free oracle-quality proxy, not a ground-truth best action. legal_candidate_recall is |proposed BuildTower candidates| / |oracle BuildTower candidates|. coverage_regret is the oracle-best candidate's route-tile coverage minus the best coverage achievable within the position-limited proposal at that sample point.
